jobs_results.title: Back End Developer (.Net)
jobs_results.description:
Enreach is a leading European provider of converged contact solutions for businesses. It provides intelligent communication technology and integrated modern telecom services that enable the agile organization. Enreach is one of the fastest growing companies within the European communication software industry with 250 Meur revenue and over 1100 employees. Enreach has 25 offices around Europe, headquartered in Almere, Netherlands.

Enreach for Enterprises is a business unit of Enreach targeting corporates and enterprises headquartered in Europe with enterprise-wide modern cloud-based communication and telephony solutions. Enreach for Enterprises business unit employs over 100 people across the Nordic countries.

In 2024, the objective is to expand Enreach for Enterprises organization and grow sales in key Enreach countries within Europe. This new development and growth phase brings new opportunities to the technology and R&D organization. We drive for continuous product and technology... innovations, including further development of global cloud-based microservices and modern cloud architectures.

Enreach for Enterprises product development team has developed a data analytics platform. We are now modernizing and improving our product portfolio by developing the Voice Analytics platform further including replacing some of the existing components, expanding current capabilities and introducing AI. Therefore we are now strengthening our product development team with two new Backend Software Developers (.Net/C#).

More specifically, your tasks will include:
• Play a key role in developing exciting new features inside the Analytics application and integrating them into our core system.
• Work in close cooperation with a team of product developers, data analytics team, QA, architects and product managers
• Produce good quality code according to our DevOps and agile product development practices
• Produce technical documentation as required
• Contribute as third-line technical support for code-related customer issues

What you´ll bring:
• A minimum of 3-4 years working as a software developer in the backend
• Knowhow on modern backend software development (e.g. Python, .NET/C#, Java, Rust, Go)
• Knowhow on databases (e.g. MSQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
• Experience in working with different messaging/data event systems (e.g. Rabbit MQ, Kafka)
• Experience in data analytics platforms is a plus (e.g. Snowflake, Power BI)
• Ability to work independently and in a multi-national team
• Good written and oral communication skills in English
• A proactive and cooperative team member
• Willingness to learn new technologies and tools and passion to produce high-quality code
• International mindset with respect for diversity

What makes us rock?
• For this position, we offer a permanent contract!
• Our flexible working hours make easier to get a life-work balance ⏰
• We can enjoy 23 days of vacation per year and 1 extra day to participate in any social responsibility activity
• Our bank holidays are flexible. You can enjoy them on the day they fall or exchange them for another day that suits you better 📅
• We have a "hybrid way of working" that allows us to combine working at home and coming to our Malaga office
• At Enreach we believe in personal growth, boosting different trainings and certifications, and offering language lessons (English and Spanish) at work!
• Flexible remuneration (public transport, healthcare insurance, restaurant ticket and kindergarten) is one of the perks that you can enjoy
• Sick leave coverage
• We love to create memorable experiences. We enjoy organizing social events to gather with colleagues a few times per year
• Join the ¨Juernes¨ every last Thursday of the month tasting some pizzas together
• We like to have fun, so in our office you can find a wide range of funny activities such as playing board games, ping pong, table football, video games, playing the guitar, eating fresh fruit, enjoying tasty coffee, or even drinking a beer with colleagues 🎯🎮
• We like to practice sports and outdoor activities together so you are welcome to join🚴

If all of this sounds interesting to you and you would like to be the new member of our family, do not hesitate to apply for the vacancy

jobs_results.title: Desarrolladores/as Backend/Front end/ fullstack (He/She/They)
jobs_results.description:
¡Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo #TEC y #SP- Sector Público en Mallorca !

¿Tienes experiencia en el desarrollo de plataformas digitales modernas? Sí tu respuesta es que sí, ¡únete a nuestro equipo! Y si no lo tienes claro... no pierdas la oportunidad de intentarlo, y ¡envíanos tu CV!

El objetivo es participar en nuevos proyectos de desarrollo y transformación digital con tecnologías nuevas en el front y en el back utilizando principalmente como stack tecnológico Spring Boot, Kubernetes… aplicando metodologías Agile, cultura DevOps y orientación hacia la automatizació

¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?

· Definir soluciones equilibradas y seguras (demanda/viabilidad).

· Diseñar e implementar técnicamente programas, módulos o modelos.

· Construir, probar y documentar elementos estructurales de la solución.

· Diseñar planes de pruebas, pruebas unitarias y de integración.

· Proporcionar soporte al equipo en su ámbito de expertise.

· Desarrollar conocimiento y capacidades necesarios en... su ámbito y que le permitan autoorganizarse y colaborar en equipo.

· Estimar esfuerzos, controlar avance, alcance, planificación y priorización.

Requisitos valorables:

· Experiencia de 3 años o superior en el diseño técnico y desarrollo de software, ejecución de pruebas, documentación de proyecto.

Formato de trabajo:

En NTT Data apostamos por un modelo de trabajo flexible con posibilidades de trabajar tanto presencialmente en nuestras nuevas oficinas en Barcelona así como con las opciones de full remote y en un formato híbrido.

Tenemos un modelo de carreras personalizado con revisión salarial semestral, apuesta clara por la formación continua (técnica, metodológica y competencial), acceso a certificaciones, diferentes modalidades de trabajo (incluyendo el teletrabajo), conciliación laboral (flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de verano) y beneficios sociales (seguro de vida, mutua de salud y ayuda flexible que te permitirán destinar tu retribución flexible a aquello que necesites).

También podrás formar parte de "The Blue Wave", el equipo de voluntariado de la compañía que participa en iniciativas de acción social y medioambiental apoyando a los colectivos que más lo necesitan. En NTT DATA avanzamos todos a la vez, por una misma causa y con una energía única. Eso es The Blue Wave, el Portal de Voluntariado (The Blue Wave (nttdatavolunteering.com).

#Together, Grow as One #One heart, one NTT DATA. Future at Heart

¿Quieres conocernos?

NTT DATA somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes.

¿Nuestra misión? Ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría. Todo gracias a la colaboración entre equipos, la calidad humana de nuestra gente y a que no nos conformamos con lo establecido, buscamos siempre la innovación que nos acerca al futuro. Nuestro talento nos ha hecho poder decir con orgullo que somos una de las 6 empresas TOP de tecnologías en el mundo.

En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad.

#WeAreAS #Front #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique #TheDigitalLovers

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola! Somos CAPGEMINI, una compañía TOP EMPLOYER con 360.000 PERSONAS en todo el mundo unidas por una misma pasión: liderar la evolución hacia un futuro sostenible e inclusivo a través de la TECNOLOGÍA. No importa dónde estemos, podemos estar en casa, en la oficina, a mil quilómetros de distancia unxs de otrxs, pero somos conscientes de que NUESTRO TRABAJO CUENTA.No importa en qué momento vital estemos, somos DIVERSOS en edad, género, ascendencia, familia… ¡nos hemos certificado en Diversidad y como empresa ÉTICA más de 10 años seguidos!

Estamos desarrollando un proyecto desafiante y para esta oportunidad, buscamos un/a Backend Developer con 5 años de experiencia con Java + SpringBoot + Cloud.

Para el desarrollo de este proyecto es imprescindible contar con conocimientos en:

Java (últimas versiones)

Springboot

Swagger

Cloud AWS (deseable)

Mockito

Unit Testing

Jenkins

Contexto Agile

Maven

Valoramos la responsabilidad, el compromiso y el trabajo en equipo.

En Capgemini... contamos con una amplísima oferta formativa, presencial, online de Certificaciones, etc. Aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos valorados ¡nos encantará conocerte!

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades hace que tengamos un Plan de Igualdad y un Código Ético que garantizan el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección dentro de un entorno libre de discriminación por cuestión de etnia, nacionalidad, origen social, edad, orientación sexual, expresión de género, religión o cualquier otra circunstancia personal, física o social.

La colaboración es clave en el desarrollo de nuevas ideas, de nuevas soluciones, del crecimiento profesional y personal y por eso para nosotrxs es vital el equipo y el buen clima. Trabajamos y potenciamos nuestras COMUNIDADES dentro de la compañía.

Tenemos un CATALOGO DE MEDIDAS de desarrollo y conciliación muy completo (ayudas familiares, seguros y tickets, días festivos adicionales de tiempo para ti y lxs tuyxs, etc…) ¿Nos vemos y te lo contamos?

Hoy has conocido algo más sobre nosotrxs y nuestro proyecto en crecimiento. Mañana saldrán otros proyectos porque así trabajamos, generando soluciones a medida que se nos necesita ¿Te unes al equipo hoy

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Wordpress Back-End
jobs_results.description:
Good Rebels, marzo 2024.

¿Te gustaría formar parte de un equipo joven y dinámico en el que aprender con proyectos de grandes marcas? En Good Rebels estamos buscando un programador que entre a formar parte de nuestro área de Tecnología donde tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollarte profesionalmente.

¿Qué buscamos? ¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

Buscamos desarrolladores web back-end que quieran formar parte de un equipo multidisciplinar orientado a la innovación en servicios on-line.

Responsabilidades
• Contribuir al diseño, arquitectura y desarrollo de proyectos Web.
• Participación en proyectos: comprender las necesidades del cliente para identificar, investigar y desarrollar soluciones técnicas para desarrollos específicos.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?

Requerimos experiencia de 2 años en:
• Desarrollo Wordpress.
• Lenguajes/entornos: PHP, Java, Node.js, .Net...
• BBDD: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB...
• Integración con servicios Web (Rest, Soap, WCF).
•... Creación de plugins y temas personalizados.
• Optimización de rendimiento y seguridad en Wordpress.

Se valorará positivamente experiencia adicional en:
• Desarrollo Frontend (HTML, CSS, Javascript).
• Configuración y gestión de entornos de despliegue.
• Manejo avanzado de Git: gestión de ramas, resolución de conflictos, aplicación de flujos de trabajo (Gitflow).
• Plataformas como Prestashop, Woocommerce, Shopify, Magento...

¿Qué esperamos también de ti?
• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
• Capacidad de análisis y aprendizaje.
• Curiosidad natural por la resolución de problemas.
• Empatía para comunicar con equipos no técnicos.
• Proactividad y capacidad resolutiva, con un alto nivel de compromiso.

Good Rebels: who we are, what we do

Good Rebels is an independent digital consultancy and agency. We create digital experiences that connect brands and people. Kind-hearted people who aren’t afraid to rebel. We combine data, design, creativity and technology to serve clients like Toyota, Domino's Pizza, LG, Lidl or Decathlon with multicultural teams from 5 offices in the UK, Spain and Mexico.

Good Rebels aim to inspire other organisations to become human-centred. We work in an open and collaborative environment that promotes love in the workplace and fun. We are a rare, self-managed, progressive company, with a very special Rebel Culture. Did you know that our salaries are public and salary raises are crowd-set?

Dragon Awards of Happiness® Culture 2022 Employer Branding category

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
More recently, we have acquired the green energy start up Umeme in order to bring the green energy revolution to the Spanish market. Read more HERE.

It's in making this vision a reality that we are looking for you to help us achieve this.

Our team

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 500 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source .

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

Our technology

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are... powered by Django, Django-REST-framework and GraphQL (Graphene).

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

What You'll Do
• We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The Spanish energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.
• We have difficult technical problems to solve. With the advent of smart meters, we'll soon be processing millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption.
• There's a great opportunity for disruption in the Spanish energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology. Octopus Energy were the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offers-transparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff
• You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK, and are funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the UK towards a lower carbon future.

What You'll Have
• We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. It would be helpful to have experience/expertise in the following (in rough priority order):
• Python
• Django (or equiv. web framework)
• Domain modelling
• HTTP and REST APIs
• Writing robust and fault-tolerant software
• Celery and async processing
• Postgres
• English & Spanish

Plus experience in the following would be a bonus:
• AWS
• Terraform, Packer, Consul
• React and Redux

You do need to be able to work in Spain/EU without a VISA though.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who thrives on providing alternative opinions, challenging those around them and being challenged

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

What You'll Do
• We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The Spanish energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.
• We have difficult technical problems to solve. With the advent of smart meters, we'll soon be processing millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption.
• There's a great opportunity for disruption in the Spanish energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology. Octopus Energy were the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offers-transparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff
• You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK, and are funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the UK towards a lower carbon future.

What You'll Have
• We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. It would be helpful to have experience/expertise in the following (in rough priority order):
• Python
• Django (or equiv. web framework)
• Domain modelling
• HTTP and REST APIs
• Writing robust and fault-tolerant software
• Celery and async processing
• Postgres
• English & Spanish

Plus experience in the following would be a bonus:
• AWS
• Terraform, Packer, Consul
• React and Redux

You do need to be able to work in Spain/EU without a VISA though.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who thrives on providing alternative opinions, challenging those around them and being challenged

jobs_results.title: Back End Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
TUI Group is the world’s number one integrated tourism business. Flight Production and Logistics is a global team within TUI technology responsible for airline reservation and passenger data. We enable TUI airlines to realise the most innovative and reliable flight products, ancillary services and passenger logistics IT solutions for our customers. We are a multi-disciplinary team of experts across Architecture, Engineering, DevOps and Agile Delivery providing services across the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Belgium and The Netherlands.

At TUI we’re ambitious to become the leader in technology within the travel industry and to achieve this we are looking to build a capable, creative team who want to be a part of accomplishing that goal.

 

We never stop looking ahead, seeking new ways to delight our customers and grow our business. We recognise the power of digital and the massive contribution this brings to creating a truly unique and differentiated... customer experience. 

 

We are looking for a talented and dedicated technical enthusiast to join our Flight Production & Passenger Logistics team.

 

The Back End Software Engineer is a practitioner and an advocate of state-of-the-art software development practices, developing software products with a broad toolkit of technologies and methods and with a strong DevOps mindset, being able to tackle the whole software development cycle of designing, building, testing and deploying applications. Working in an agile environment and keeping up with the ever-evolving technical landscape the Back End Software Engineer is a lifelong learner and likes to think outside the box.

ABOUT THE JOB:

As a Back End Software Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team or a practice team that enables software development skills and capabilities across a whole domain. Together with your team you will own the software products from conception to operation. Being an enthusiast in software engineering and software craftsmanship, with a strong DevSecOps mindset, and thanks to your excellent collaboration skills you will support your team in delivering the best answers to our customers’ needs and in taking over full responsibility for its applications, from design to operation.

You will strive for a high degree of automation, clean architectures and high quality with a customer-centric mindset. You are able to select the right tools for the right jobs and thus solve the given business and technical problems in an efficient way. You show a commercial mentality, focusing on solving business problems in the best way. You will work in a cloud environment, especially AWS, and develop resilient and high-performing cloud-native applications. You have a good understanding of the AWS toolbox, leveraging AWS services and cloud design patterns in a micro-service landscape. You can tackle the whole cycle of designing, building, testing and deploying software and contribute to increasing automation. Also Security is part of everyone’s job. At TUI, we practise secure behaviours first in everything we do. 

You are able to verbalise your thoughts and ideas and take the initiative to translate ideas into outcomes. Together with the domain’s Practice teams as well as the Group Enabler teams you also will research, evaluate and test new approaches, processes and tools and help teams to use them effectively.

You love to work in an international, multi-cultural team. You challenge constructively and have high expectations of yourself and others. You always drive for technical excellence, ownership and self-organisation at team and personal level.  You love to learn and acquire new skills and keep up to date with latest developments in your focus areas.

ABOUT YOU:
• You have a completed technical degree (e.g. computer science, business informatics) or a comparable qualification. 
• You have experience in the further development of products and services and in the implementation of customer requirements.  
• You have very good knowledge of .Net C# as well as relevant frameworks and concepts, such as .Net and Core, REST, MVC and Microservices.  
• You have good knowledge of MS SQL and MySQL database.  
• You feel conﬁdent in using Visual Studio and NUnit & Mocking frameworks (e.g. Moq) You have experience in creating modern ASP.NET applications. 
• You know about Gitlab and AWS CodePipeline (CloudFormation).
• You have a very good command of English (written and spoken).  
• You are familiar with Agile software development and DevOps and have worked with these before.
• You are a team player and love to find solutions for complex problems in a joint fashion. 
• You have first experiences and knowledge on agile ways of working (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and want to take responsibility for steadily improving the work processes and interaction within the team. 

OUR OFFER:
• Being a valuable team member of TUI, the No.1 global and socially aware travel company.
• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Smart working (Flexible hours) and possibility of working remotely up to 100% or Hybrid from one of our offices.
• Develop yourself as part of a friendly, richly, diverse and virtual international team.

If you want to know more about why TUI Group is the world's leading tourism group, and our continuing work in the diversity & inclusion space, simply visit careers.tuigroup.com

#TUIjobs

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Back End
jobs_results.description:
Why you should join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health, and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 800+ teammates from 25+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

As our Senior Java Developer you will build... high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications. You will be part of a talented software team that works on mission-critical applications with big customers.

What will I be doing?
• Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle
• Designing, developing and delivering high-volume, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems
• Write well designed, testable, efficient code
• Ensure designs are in compliance with specifications
• Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review

What skills do I need?
• Proven hands-on Software Development experience
• Proven working experience in Java development
• Hands on experience in designing and developing applications using Java platforms
• Object Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns
• Profound insight of Java
• Experience in working/designing microservices
• Good knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate). NoSql knowledge is desirable
• Experience in Spring Framework
• Experience with test-driven development
• AWS knowledge is a plus
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git
• Written and spoken English
• Ability to work independently
• Be a team player

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal

jobs_results.title: Back-end developer
jobs_results.description:
About Diprotech

Welcome to DiproTech, where innovation meets excellence.

We’re a dynamic engineering company, home to thethings.io – our cutting-edge IoT platform serving clients in 25+ countries. With a focus on technical prowess and ethical standards, we deliver tailored solutions and unwavering support, driving innovation and ensuring client satisfaction.

Join us in shaping the future of engineering and IoT solutions.

Position Overview

As a Back End Developer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers our applications and services. Your expertise will be crucial in enhancing the efficiency and performance of our systems.

Key Responsibilities
• Development and Maintenance: Contribute to the development and maintenance of server-side logic and functionality for our applications.
• Database Integration: Collaborate on the integration and management of databases.
• Code Optimization: Actively participate in maintaining... and optimizing existing code to ensure efficient performance.
• Feature Implementation: Develop new features and services, ensuring effective and efficient implementation.
• Technical Communication: Collaborate with internal teams and occasionally with clients to communicate technical aspects and find joint solutions.
• Technical Meetings: Participate in technical meetings to discuss projects, troubleshoot issues, and contribute innovative ideas.

Technical Skills Required
• Solid experience in Node.js.
• Proficiency in libraries such as Express, Mongoose, Ioredis, Moment, Async, Lodash, Nodemailer, Joi.
• Preferably experience with MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra.
• Advanced knowledge of Docker and Git.
• Familiarity with tools like WSL, NVM, and AWS.
• Experience with communication protocols, preferably UDP, MQTT, HTTP, Websockets.
• Preferably knowledge in IoT, Python.
• Knowledge of Rust and DevOps is a plus.

This is your position if you
• Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Stand out in problem-solving and optimizing code for efficient performance.
• Approach challenges with patience and humility, fostering continuous learning. 📚
• Navigate evolving projects and technologies with adaptability.
• Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in development and optimization tasks. 💡

What we offer
• Young team and good environment for growth. 🪴
• Flexible hours. 🕐
• Flexible WFH.
• Full-time job.
• On-site English classes for skill enhancement. 👩🏫

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Backend .NET Senior
jobs_results.description:
En IT Partner estamos en la búsqueda de un/a desarrollador/a backend .NET Senior para un apasionante proyecto ubicado en Valencia. ¿Estás listo/a para un nuevo desafío en tu carrera profesional?

Tareas

Liderar y coordinar los desarrollos del equipo técnico asignado.

Resolver analizar y documentar las incidencias complejas que surjan en los proyectos.

Participar activamente en las reuniones tanto con el cliente como con el equipo aportando tu experiencia y conocimientos.

Supervisar y garantizar la calidad de las entregas asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de desarrollo.

Estimar y supervisar el tiempo y los recursos necesarios para los diferentes desarrollos o peticiones.

Coordinar y realizar despliegues a distintos entornos en los clientes asegurando una implementación exitosa.

Elaborar y mantener actualizada la documentación técnica del proyecto.

Mentorizar y formar a nuevos miembros del equipo compartiendo tus conocimientos y mejores prácticas.

Colaborar en la... mejora continua de los procesos de desarrollo de software.

Participar en la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones técnicas aportando tu experiencia y visión.

Trabajo 2 días desde la oficina y 3 en remoto (Valencia)

Requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 5 años en el desarrollo de tecnologías .NET incluyendo ASP.NET Framework C# ASP.NET Web Forms Spring.NET IoC container WebAPI Rest y web services SQL y Git.

Amplios conocimientos de patrones de programación como Herencia Polimorfismo Abstracción Encapsulamiento Factory Inyección de dependencias Inversión de Control.

Experiencia en pruebas unitarias y metodologías ágiles.

Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática o similar.

Requisitos Deseables

Experiencia avanzada con microservicios en .NET y Web API REST con ASP.NET Core > v3.1.

Dominio de ORM con Microsoft Entity Framework.

Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de arquitecturas escalables y resilientes.

Conocimientos avanzados en cache Redis u otros sistemas de cache clave-valor.

Experiencia en contenerización de APIs con Docker o containerd.

Experiencia con bases de datos NoSQL como MongoDB y bases de datos relacionales con Microsoft SQL Server.

Experiencia en el desarrollo y despliegue de aplicaciones en entornos de cloud (Azure AWS GCP).

Certificaciones relevantes en tecnologías .NET.

¿Crees que encajas con este perfil y estás listo/a para asumir este emocionante reto? ¡No dudes en enviarnos tu CV! Estamos ansiosos por conocer a un/a profesional como tú y trabajar juntos en este proyecto innovador.
• Net, ASP.Net, API Rest, .Net Core
